observation.note: Relayed actor observations; interrupted CUA calls and exact input timing are not counted as product failures. Source review independently establishes the missing caret-tail handling.

cause: The replacement range excluded already-entered spaces or partial text before the caret. Unicode insertion ended at the replacement word, leaving the caret before that tail. The next word could be inserted before the space.
fix: For an empty selection, extend the selected replacement range through the original caret and append the unchanged tail to the same Unicode input batch. Avoid resetting a selection after newer input.

rapid_driver.owner_permission: Explicitly received for Windows driver in owned Chrome fixture; forwarded to Windows actor.

earlier_receipts: The 22 Notepad and 15 Chrome checks belong to the affected old build. Their passes do not cover sequential correction with a second word after the first correction.
